title: Three profile flows find coaches and guides, venues and hosts, and local businesses beside the Saturation Engine, and no one hears from two flows
description: Daniel (2026-11-18): keep the primary saturation flow and add three flows that work with Frequency's profiles: coaches and guides, venues and event hosts, and local businesses engaged in the community, each designed to find the people hosting these things. A profile is a shipped preset for a copy of neighborhood-activation, in flows/neighborhood-activation/profiles/<slug>.json: its name and note, a config patch merged one level deep over the base config (hunts.playbook with seek, signals, where, queries, skip, rank, record and note; hunts.link_line; niches with angles and an optional door; the profile's /for page as funnels.host.path and dm_door.path) and its starter hunts. POST /v1/supervisor/flows/{base}/copy { profile } makes the copy <base>--<slug> from it, off and at draft; the Owner's own slug, name, note and config still win, and an unknown profile is 400. A cycle whose config has a playbook builds its hunt brief from it instead of the event lines; the base flow's brief is unchanged. A lead's link opens its niche's door when the niche names one, else the flow's. The base flow and every copy share one do-not-contact list and one record of who was drafted for, read at screening time from each one's state.json, while caps stay per flow. Draft only: nothing here sends. Editing a copy's hunts from the API or the site is a later row.
acceptance: coaches-guides, venues-hosts and local-businesses ship as profiles; each makes a copy with its own name, playbook, niches, page and starter hunt, and keeps the base sign-off, offer address and territories
An unknown profile answers 400 and makes nothing; the same profile twice answers 409
A run of a profile copy drafts into the copy's own folder, every draft links to the profile's page after its link line and waits for the Owner, and nothing reaches the outbox
An address on the base flow's do-not-contact list is blocked in a copy, and a contact a copy drafted for is a duplicate to the base flow
The hunts, flow-copies, saturation-engine and seed-config checks still pass
